PathOfBuilding.Notes:
Leveling I know i have whirling blades in the leveling setup but you wont use it til level 12 or until you find useable 1 handers early. Remember you want to put 1.6 attack speed rares on you filter for Swords, foils, and claws. Add the following weapons to your filters. Under highlight specific bases add : Whalebone rapier , jagged foil , elegant foil. serrated foil, fancy foil , rusted sword, sabre, cutlass, nail fist, cats paw , sparkling claw, tiger's paw, noble claw. Select "RARE" any item level.
League start regex g-g-g|g-[gr]-r|r-[gr]-g|g-r-g|r-g-r|Runn|rint|s:.+(sw|cl)
